precisionConventions.archive.org: no precision field; `date` is uploader-typed and describes the FILE not the work — UNUSED as `at`. Year evidence comes from the FILENAME.
precisionConventions.Wikidata: EXPLICIT integer precision (8 decade / 9 year / 10 month / 11 day). Raw JSON zero-fills (+1970-00-00); SPARQL start-pads (1970-01-01). Same fact, two paddings, one declared precision.
precisionConventions.Europeana/EDM: the date LITERAL survives ("1970") — precision is the string length. Honest by omission.
precisionConventions.ERR (arhiiv.err.ee, for contrast): no precision field; year-only MIDPOINT-padded to YYYY-07-15 — indistinguishable from an attested 15 July. Must be reverse-engineered.
